display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Command of the Mastermind F
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives the Mastermind an aura that boosts the Area of Effect Defense of nearby henchmen and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This enhancement can only be slotted in a Mastermind pet power.
